verdict.rationale: Mem0 offers a Memory Export feature using customizable Pydantic schemas, plus open-source self-hosting where 'you own the stack, the data, and every component,' giving users control over their data. However, export is schema-defined/structured rather than a full open-format data dump, and there's no evidence of bulk export to standard open formats (e.g., JSON/CSV of all raw memories) or a documented account-deletion/data-portability workflow. missing for 10: evidence of full raw-data export in a standard open format, documented full-account data portability/deletion process, independent verification of export completeness.
